rows.accepted_decision: Existing runtime host owns presentation authority
rows.requirement_summary: Browser Session Manager uses one typed in-process provider; no second daemon or provider database is authoritative.
tests_evidence: CodeGraph frozen closure shows the in-process host seam but also a competing JSON handoff authority.
rows.remaining_gap: Cut ordinary handoff finalization and presentation authority over to the runtime host and SQLite only.

rows.requirement_summary: Installer stores policy only; provider deterministically owns route slots, users, credentials, connections, and display observations.
tests_evidence: The default Browser Session Manager no longer reads AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION_DISPLAY and always derives current route and route-user bindings from SQLite RouteKeeperAuthority; strict Clippy passes and P02 now has zero findings.
rows.remaining_gap: Replace the retained installer route-credential environment projection and add complete deterministic provider-owned route-inventory coverage before acceptance.

rows.accepted_decision: Legacy policy and runtime JSON are migration-only
rows.requirement_summary: One forward-only cold-upgrade migration imports valid state, records hashes and typed rejects, archives inputs read-only, removes legacy authority and exact owned processes, and never falls back; provider rows are rebuilt.
tests_evidence: Migration fixtures exist, but the frozen closure proves the default host and ordinary handoff still consume legacy JSON after SQLite exists.
rows.remaining_gap: Make legacy JSON a one-time archived migration input and remove every post-migration read or write.

rows.requirement_summary: Ordinary browser, profile, session, tab, handoff, operation, presentation, configuration, history, cleanup, and provider-credential state has one transactional authority; JSON is limited to exports and diagnostics outside ordinary runtime dependencies.
tests_evidence: Frozen dependency closure records the SQLite session side and JSON acquisition/handoff side as a split authority.
rows.remaining_gap: Move all ordinary handoff, operation, presentation, credential, history and cleanup state into one SQLite transaction boundary.

rows.requirement_summary: Malformed, contradictory, ambiguous, or stale history stays diagnostic and cannot block a fresh valid browser request.
tests_evidence: No current stale-history admission tests inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect history handling and fresh-request behavior under malformed and contradictory history.

rows.requirement_summary: Startup reconstructs capacity; minimumReady=1 unlocks service while warmTarget=4 warms in background; readiness requires a complete Guacamole, XRDP, and display path.
tests_evidence: Defaults minimumReady=1 and warmTarget=4 and provider-free readiness fencing exist; joined provider cold-start evidence is absent.
rows.remaining_gap: Remove the development provider readiness interlock and prove one complete live path before service readiness.

rows.accepted_decision: Ordinary open waits for real capacity
rows.requirement_summary: Open waits to the configured deadline (provisionally 90 seconds) and returns typed timeout or exhaustion before Chrome launch.
tests_evidence: Typed 90-second default and reservation-before-launch seams exist; joined timeout with fresh process readback has not run.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove timeout and exhaustion occur before any Chrome launch in the installed development runtime.

rows.requirement_summary: In-process protocol route keepers retain XRDP without Chrome, profile, tab, handoff, or Browser Session Manager records.
tests_evidence: Provider-free route-keeper protocol state is separate from BrowserSessionManager; no installed fresh-process residue proof exists.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove the joined Guacamole and XRDP keeper starts and retains routes without Chrome or browser-session records.

rows.accepted_decision: Displays and browsers have deterministic placement
rows.requirement_summary: Use one browser per display while capacity grows; at provisional six displays allow least-loaded sharing up to provisional density four, with both limits configurable and subject to G33.
tests_evidence: CodeGraph found bounded_desktop_admission_grows_before_sharing_and_preserves_existing_browsers; this covers a deterministic placement case, not configured six-display/four-density production conformance.
rows.remaining_gap: Map live typed limits, provider health placement, six/four defaults, and full acceptance evidence.

rows.requirement_summary: After capacity limits, a bounded queue (provisionally 32) prioritizes recovery, handoff access, then aged FIFO opens; duplicates coalesce.
tests_evidence: The typed depth default and durable capacity-operation foundations exist; the full priority and coalescing contract is not accepted.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove recovery then handoff then aged-FIFO ordering, exact bound, and duplicate-operation coalescing.

rows.requirement_summary: One fenced per-display Desktop Services lease governs handoff activation and desktop input; opening another browser visibly transfers control and prior viewers become view-only.
tests_evidence: Extracted Desktop Services transaction contracts and atomic-control fixtures exist; joined visible transfer evidence is absent.
rows.remaining_gap: Move the control adapter off legacy JSON and prove visible transfer with prior viewers remaining view-only.

rows.requirement_summary: One opaque authenticated /remote-view/<handoff-id> survives runtime, provider, display, browser, and tab recovery for the logical session, ending only by explicit close, retention, or typed unrecoverable condition.
tests_evidence: Opaque client handoff interface and manager handoff persistence exist, but frozen closure proves competing persistence paths.
rows.remaining_gap: Unify handoff identity in SQLite and prove survival through every named recovery boundary.

rows.requirement_summary: Resolution restores capacity and exactly one same-profile browser, recreates the tab at the committed URL, focuses/maximizes, and returns the viewer without replaying page effects.
tests_evidence: Provider-free recovery and no-second-launch foundations exist; full joined recovery and no-page-effect acceptance remain absent.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove capacity restoration, singular replacement, committed-URL recreation, focus/maximize, viewer return, and no effect replay.

rows.accepted_decision: Recovery is eager only when useful
rows.requirement_summary: Baseline capacity and active viewers recover eagerly; dormant browsers recover lazily on handoff or named-session access.
tests_evidence: No recovery scheduling evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove eager baseline/active-viewer and lazy dormant recovery behavior.

rows.requirement_summary: Active recovery preserves handoff and retries with bounded backoff; proves old browser unusable before at most one replacement and avoids competing replacements.
tests_evidence: No bounded retry or competing-replacement test inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect retry budget, old-browser proof, and concurrent recovery serialization.

rows.requirement_summary: Persist compact lifecycle, navigation, display, replacement, recovery, and compaction events; exclude raw logs, screenshots, bodies, heartbeats, and repeated polls.
tests_evidence: Structured navigation history and a 64 MiB configuration default exist; operational compaction and exclusion enforcement are absent.
rows.remaining_gap: Implement and test compact lifecycle/recovery history, exclusion rules, and enforced bounds.

rows.requirement_summary: Retain material lifecycle/recovery indefinitely; cap exact URL transitions at 64 MiB and summarize oldest navigation by day with auditable compaction details.
tests_evidence: The 64 MiB setting exists, but no daily summary or auditable compaction operation was found.
rows.remaining_gap: Implement deterministic daily compaction summaries and preserve material events plus a compaction receipt.

rows.requirement_summary: Use durable WAL, integrity checks, one rotating verified online backup, 96 MiB live target and 128 MiB routine total budget; preserve corrupt DBs and record restore gaps.
tests_evidence: SQLite and 96/128 MiB defaults exist; verified online backup, integrity handling, corruption preservation and restore-gap evidence are absent.
rows.remaining_gap: Implement integrity checks, rotating verified backup, corruption preservation, bounded restore, and restoration-gap history.

rows.requirement_summary: Admission, browser, presentation reservation, and handoff share one durable operation; waiting work does not launch after restart, begun effects reconcile/compensate, and clients resume by operation ID.
tests_evidence: Provider-free reserved and observed-launch recovery fixtures exist, but ordinary handoff completion is still a separate JSON transaction.
rows.remaining_gap: Commit admission, browser, reservation and handoff under one SQLite operation and prove waiting versus begun restart behavior.

rows.accepted_decision: Privilege is installed once and used only as needed
rows.requirement_summary: Initial install may establish one narrow noninteractive helper; healthy cold starts use zero privileged calls; exact repairs record before/action/after and never broadly restart shared XRDP.
tests_evidence: No helper privilege or repair receipt evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect installer/helper scope, cold-start calls, and typed repair receipts.

rows.requirement_summary: Live settings default to 24 inactive hours, 20 profiles, and 10 GiB; oldest inactive disposable sessions expire first and protected/named/active sessions are not evicted; no separate pin state exists.
tests_evidence: 24-hour, 20-profile and 10 GiB defaults plus exact cleanup eligibility exist; full count/byte mutation and oldest-first protected cleanup do not.
rows.remaining_gap: Complete quota measurement, oldest-inactive ordering, protected refusal, and exact profile deletion.

rows.requirement_summary: Typed Service config and config get/set own accepted operational settings transactionally; dashboard remains read-only; mutable environment policy is not authority.
tests_evidence: Typed defaults exist, but BrowserRuntimeConfigPatch exposes only seven presentation fields and mutable environment authority remains.
rows.remaining_gap: Expose every accepted mutable setting through typed config get/set and remove environment policy authority.

rows.requirement_summary: Ordinary named-profile open cannot be denied by lease admission, historical owner proof, quarantine, cleanup obligations, or equivalent metadata; only current concrete failures may deny it.
tests_evidence: P217 proves initial remote_view_open classification skips profile-lease admission, but the frozen closure still reaches runtime-owner and cleanup records during handoff finalization.
rows.remaining_gap: Remove all lease, owner, custody, quarantine and cleanup-obligation consultation from the complete ordinary path.

rows.requirement_summary: Implementation and validation occur in isolated development runtime; production, ingress, release, and merge need separate authority after accepted development evidence.
tests_evidence: No development acceptance evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Establish isolated development candidate and evidence; this packet performs inventory only.

rows.accepted_decision: Provider credentials follow the SQLite authority
rows.requirement_summary: Generated provider credentials exist authoritatively only in private SQLite and are projected transiently; temporary files are removed at shutdown and route-user rotation preserves handoff identity.
state_stores: persistent environment and generated unit inputs
tests_evidence: P218 red gate finds XRDP route username/password environment keys; SQLite credential schema alone does not establish custody.
rows.remaining_gap: Make SQLite the only credential authority, project secrets transiently, remove them on shutdown, and prove rotation preserves handoff identity.

rows.requirement_summary: Each runtime-host start claims a monotonic generation; provider/browser effects, callbacks, completion, and recovery commits require current generation plus operation ID.
tests_evidence: Generation and CAS foundations plus stale route-keeper effect tests exist; every callback and recovery commit is not yet covered by one generation-plus-operation fence.
rows.remaining_gap: Unify generation and operation fencing across provider effects, browser effects, callbacks, completion and recovery commits.

rows.requirement_summary: Prefer unused healthy displays, then least-loaded healthy display; ordinary operation preserves a browser's binding and only bounded failure recovery may rebind it.
tests_evidence: CodeGraph found a fixture checking growth-before-sharing and preservation of existing assignments under a bounded capacity case.
rows.remaining_gap: Verify health-aware placement and show ordinary operations cannot rebind a healthy browser.

rows.requirement_summary: Only an empty exact-reference-free display above warmTarget retires after configurable cooldown; final browser, handoff, viewer, operation, and keeper checks precede effect.
tests_evidence: Provider-free cooldown and browser/handoff reference exclusions exist; full final viewer, operation and keeper reference proof remains unaccepted.
rows.remaining_gap: Complete the exact final reference check and prove joined provider scale-in after cooldown only.

rows.requirement_summary: Valid config updates commit transactionally and apply without restart; lower-than-usage limits report over-target and stop worsening admissions while ordinary release converges without killing work.
tests_evidence: Atomic config CAS and non-rebinding capacity application exist; complete live settings and over-target status/admission behavior are incomplete.
rows.remaining_gap: Complete configuration mutation, over-target reporting and non-worsening admission without eviction.

rows.requirement_summary: Status and doctor report configured/observed capacity, keepers, generations, browser counts, operations, queue, control, recovery, migration, integrity/size, pressure, and repair receipts while redacting secrets and raw URLs.
tests_evidence: No status/doctor field or redaction evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Map required fields to status/doctor output and verify redaction and read-only behavior.

rows.requirement_summary: Repeated/concurrent open for same logical session and tab reuses one handoff and operation; new logical tabs get distinct handoffs; closure terminalizes prior handoffs.
tests_evidence: Named-session repeated command reuse exists; exact concurrent remote-view operation and handoff coalescing remains split across stores.
rows.remaining_gap: Coalesce concurrent ordinary opens under one SQLite operation and handoff, and terminalize prior handoffs on explicit closure.

rows.accepted_decision: Recovery URL means committed top-level navigation
rows.requirement_summary: Persist only committed top-level Chrome navigation, including operator navigation; ignore provisional redirects, subframes, and bootstrap pages; retain bounded redirects and recover final committed URL.
tests_evidence: Navigation recovery journal fixtures exist; exact-target observation now reads the committed root frame, and journal publication excludes blank bootstrap pages; a focused replay fixture rejects a pre-existing identical URL as issued-effect proof. Operator navigation capture, retained redirect sequence, and end-to-end CDP qualification remain unproven.
rows.remaining_gap: Capture operator-driven committed top-level CDP events, retain bounded redirect history, and qualify the browser-to-SQLite path with real CDP navigation evidence.

rows.requirement_summary: Every browser launch passes current memory/process/disk admission; typed rejection leaves existing resources undisturbed; development stress validates or lowers provisional density four.
tests_evidence: No resource-pressure admission or development stress evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect live admission signals, non-disruptive rejection, and density stress evidence.

rows.requirement_summary: Agent Browser-owned Guacamole rows/users/connections/sharing/routes/displays/leases are disposable derived infrastructure rebuilt from SQLite policy and operator inputs.
tests_evidence: Additive catalog and provisioning replay fixtures exist; cold-upgrade rebuild of the complete owned provider namespace is not accepted.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove forward-only cold upgrade rebuilds every owned provider row and never imports route IDs, displays or leases as authority.

rows.requirement_summary: Only an authenticated remote-view connection and live Guacamole tunnel with bounded heartbeat/disconnect detection proves an active viewer.
tests_evidence: Persisted ViewerLease state and mutation dispatch are removed; capacity and attachability conservatively project no active viewer, and configured desktop interaction fails with authenticated_live_viewer_authority_unavailable.
rows.remaining_gap: Implement authenticated live Guacamole tunnel observation with bounded heartbeat and disconnect detection; current fail-closed absence is not accepted live-viewer behavior.

rows.requirement_summary: Named handoffs have no default expiry; disposable handoffs expire after configured inactivity, terminalize session/handoff, reference-check and delete profile, and retain compact history; browser reclamation preserves recoverable identities.
tests_evidence: No handoff expiry/profile deletion/reclamation evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect named versus disposable retention and terminal cleanup with recovery preservation.

rows.requirement_summary: Count and byte quotas use oldest-inactive-first cleanup; protected sessions cause typed quota/low-disk refusal, never named/protected deletion.
tests_evidence: No count/byte quota evidence inspected.
rows.remaining_gap: Inspect quota admission, protected-session handling, and exact cleanup ordering.

rows.requirement_summary: No disposable pinning or profile-promotion exists in this plan; every disposable profile remains subject to expiry and quotas until an explicit future feature.
tests_evidence: No complete promotion/pinning source search performed.
rows.remaining_gap: Verify absence of promotion/pinning state across ordinary compiled surfaces.

rows.requirement_summary: Doctor only observes/recommends; startup, requests, and explicit repair may use the same narrow typed reconciler without arbitrary commands or broad restart authority.
tests_evidence: Existing doctor contract is treated as read-only by source guard, but the shared typed reconciler and narrow privileged repair boundary are not fully mapped.
rows.remaining_gap: Add deterministic no-mutation coverage and prove every repair action is typed and narrowly privileged.

rows.requirement_summary: Queued operation identity/outcome persists, but work only waiting at restart is retryable and launches only after client resume; begun effects reconcile or compensate.
tests_evidence: Begun-effect recovery foundations exist; the exact waiting-request restart-and-resume fixture has not been accepted.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove queued-only work becomes retryable and cannot launch until the client resumes the same operation.

rows.accepted_decision: Legacy lease denial is physically quarantined
rows.requirement_summary: Trusted CLI/runtime/Service model do not compile, link, embed, deserialize, expose, or dispatch Lease Authority/runtime-owner/recovery/dashboard/MCP code; crate remains independently buildable and historical data is diagnostic only.
tests_evidence: P218 red gate finds both direct Cargo dependencies and compiled product references; the standalone crate architecture test proves only extraction, not product quarantine.
rows.remaining_gap: Remove all default-product dependency edges, types, serialization and dispatch while retaining only an independently buildable migration decoder/tool.

rows.requirement_summary: One Browser Session Manager owns ordinary lifecycle; named sessions bind profile/browser/tab/activity/expiry/handoffs; success refreshes exact session and current heartbeat plus direct process observation determine liveness.
tests_evidence: Focused service-model coverage proves distinct Alice/Bob handoff membership and exact-session activity refresh; host coverage proves handoff resolution persists only Alice's heartbeat while Bob is unchanged; SQLite reload backfills only fully attributed ready legacy handoffs; keeper compatibility publication now commits membership and handoff in one SQLite transaction; the SQLite Alice/Bob managed-command regression failed before the fix and passes after it, proving failed commands retain tab attribution without refreshing Alice, successful commands refresh Alice, and Bob remains unchanged; failed navigation now retains attribution without refreshing Alice or Bob and success records Alice; focused service-model tests, formatting, and strict Clippy pass. Dashboard routing fixtures prove exact Bob handoff membership in a shared browser and reject stale manager JSON projection; journaled manager open no longer dual-writes the already committed SQLite handoff.
rows.remaining_gap: Qualify journaled navigation and the remaining ordinary command variants for success-only exact-session heartbeat publication. Prove every handoff-finalization path uses the manager-owned SQLite transaction boundary, then remove the remaining route-bound JSON finalizer and legacy manager attachment paths identified by P03 and P05.

rows.requirement_summary: Same exact profile may share a healthy browser while sessions, tabs, targets, heartbeats, expiries, and handoffs remain distinct; one session's actions cannot affect another.
tests_evidence: The ordinary provider-free SQLite host fixture shared_browser_commands_and_cleanup_remain_session_scoped_in_sqlite proves one browser with distinct Alice/Bob sessions, tabs, targets, opaque handoffs, and exact heartbeat refresh; it also proves Bob remains commandable after Alice closes. The ignored workstation e2e expresses navigation and click isolation but is not current acceptance evidence.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove independent navigation and click effects, distinct expiry, and the same isolation through ordinary remote_view_open and browser-backed acceptance.

rows.requirement_summary: Closing/expiring one of multiple sessions removes only its session/tab; browser closes after the final active session; reopening a healthy named session reuses existing identity.
tests_evidence: The ordinary provider-free SQLite host fixture proves Alice-first tab cleanup preserves Bob and the browser, Bob remains commandable, final-session close invokes browser close, and reopening Alice reuses her session, browser, tab, and handoff. Focused model tests cover expiry; the ignored workstation fixture checks real process termination.
rows.remaining_gap: Prove browser-backed final process termination and expiry isolation through the ordinary remote_view_open path; the current fixture uses provider-free effects and the manager host.

rows.accepted_decision: Session and viewer heartbeats stay distinct
rows.requirement_summary: Session heartbeat governs logical retention; authenticated Guacamole connection heartbeat governs viewer activity/recovery/control; neither heartbeat creates lease/admission authority or derives from stored history.
tests_evidence: Session heartbeat is separately modeled and persisted viewer-heartbeat actions are removed, but operator focus still accepts stored controller ID and epoch without current authenticated Guacamole heartbeat evidence.
rows.remaining_gap: Add the process-local authenticated Guacamole heartbeat and require it for viewer activity, eager recovery, and continued Desktop Services control; stored controller fencing alone is insufficient.
